title: 2026 U.S. congressional midterms: Missouri map dispute heads back toward Supreme Court
summary: A U.S. appeals court backed a Republican-drawn Missouri congressional map, but its ruling was paused until September 28 while the Supreme Court has time to respond.

title: Grok 4.7 is introduced for coding and knowledge work
summary: xAI introduced Grok 4.7 with a larger base model, longer reinforcement-learning training on difficult tasks and an emphasis on checking work more carefully.

title: Saudi Arabia unveils CEER EXOBOT electric sedan and SUV
summary: Saudi automotive brand CEER revealed an electric sedan and SUV under the EXOBOT name.

title: Trump approval measured at 32% in new Reuters/Ipsos poll
summary: A Reuters/Ipsos poll of 1,277 U.S. adults found 32% approval for President Donald Trump and a 43%-35% Democratic-Republican split among registered voters asked which party they would support for Congress.

title: CERN begins disconnecting the LHC for the High-Luminosity upgrade
summary: CERN has begun disconnecting and dismantling focusing magnets around ATLAS and CMS as part of the third long shutdown.

title: XRISM observes a pulsar gathering a companion star’s wind
summary: XRISM observations captured evidence of a giant star’s wind being captured by its neutron-star companion.
